issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() with a return type of void, but the textual description and the solution implementation state that this method should return a String (format: "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)"). This mismatch between the UML and the rest of the materials can confuse students about the correct method signature and return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md so that getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() has the correct return type String (i.e. +getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String). Ensure the UML, textual description, and template comments consistently state the same return type.
